title: Breakfast on the Shore
reflectionQuestion: Jesus made a warm breakfast for his tired friends, just because he loved them. I wonder what cozy moment makes you feel safe and loved?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Easter / post-resurrection, John 21:1-14). Adam's sleeper-favorite pick. Distinct from 1883 Nets Full of Fish (Luke 5, the FIRST catch / calling) -- this is the post-resurrection SECOND catch + breakfast. WATCH-ITEM (Adam): linger on the fire, the smell of bread, the lake at sunrise -- the COZINESS is the point; no crowd, no spectacle, no sermon. mood=calm_peaceful (a cozy bedtime-adjacent piece). Peter's joyful jump kept; Peter's restoration kept offstage to preserve the gentle warmth. Room = Jesus' gentle, human care / belonging / he is alive and loves us. Soft close ('say'). VOICE_JOHN_BELOVED (John 21 is John's own gospel; tender).
